title: 30-A Beach Properties: Green Turtle Grove Cottage in Rosemary Beach – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: 30-A Beach Properties: Green Turtle Grove Cottage in Rosemary Beach. 30-A Beach Properties presents Green Turtle Grove Cottage in Rosemary Beach, A Renovated, Award-Winning Coastal Retreat, South of 30A, ideally situated directly on Rosemary Beach
description_expanded:
30-A Beach Properties presents Green Turtle Grove Cottage in Rosemary Beach, A Renovated, Award-Winning Coastal Retreat, South of 30A, ideally situated directly on Rosemary Beach’s iconic Boardwalk F with Gulf Views.

*** SLEEPS 12 WITH CARRIAGE HOUSE (separate fee).

Tucked beneath a grove of mature coastal trees, and moments from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, Green Turtle Grove is a beautifully renovated Rosemary Beach retreat designed for gathering, relaxing, and creating memories with family and friends...

Features:

· Two-story Main House that comfortably sleeps 8 ideally situated directly on Rosemary Beach’s iconic Boardwalk F

· Effortless 1-minute stroll to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf

· Gulf views from multiple decks and outdoor spaces

· Just steps (1 minute) to Main Street & Barrett Square’s boutiques, cafés, and dining

- Keurig and Drip Coffee Makers

· All new appliances including an LG Styler Steam Closet to prepare your outfits to look their best

- Sony Smart Tv's

· Freshly renovated with refined finishes, new furniture, paint, and refinished floors in a thoughtful coastal design

· Private outdoor hot & cold showers, perfect after beach days

· Charming courtyard seating for morning coffee or evening gatherings, including a grilling area

· Green Turtle Grove Carriage House is also available (sleeps 4). Ideal for couples, families, or multi-generational stays

· One Dedicated garage parking space

· 2nd Floor Loft over living room with dedicated soft spaces including workspace and cozy reading nooks

· Winner of Southern Living magazine “Southern Home Award”

MAIN HOUSE: Sleeps 8 with 6 beds, 2.5 bathrooms, dedicated private hot/cold outdoor shower

1st FLOOR: Primary bedroom: king bed, ensuite bathroom with shower

Powder room – half bath

2nd FLOOR: Bedroom 2: queen bed with private balcony and partial Gulf view

Bedroom 3: 4 twin XL bunk beds, each with dedicated power and lighting, ample storage

Full bathroom with walk-in shower, dual vanities, water closet
